about: Table-only model-to-hex bindings. --cycle names the hex valid cycle. A positive default spinup starts model inference one model step earlier, so even a zero source lead initializes hex from a forecast rather than an analysis. Other source leads retain the common valid-time contract. Rust composition owns arrays and verifies the pressure mapping. Research-only rows require each exact licence name; unresolved grants remain refused.
